currentParagraphText: “Isn’t it possible he is not using a skill but is doing something self-taught?”

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “Isn’t it possible he is not using a skill but is doing something self-taught?”
finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Theoretically, but I don’t think so,” Jake shook his head. “Clearly, there are some things he cannot simply teach himself, such as the ability to give out Blessings. Meditate seems to be a very system-heavy skill that I simply can't imagine how he discovered in the first place, no matter how much time he spent. I can’t imagine how he would form that initial connection to the system. That’s why I’ve chosen to believe that he got the Meditate skill upon becoming a god… something all gods do.”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “He may not have it,” the First Sage proposed an alternative.
